title: Love it perfect size for small items
text:
Love it perfect size for small items. Use it at my vanity for small items
So cute and perfect size

product_metadata.title: simplehuman 1.5 Liter / 0.4 Gallon Mini Countertop Trash Can, Rose Gold Stainless Steel
features: balanced swing lid: Centre-weighted swing lid opens easily and then gently swings back into place.

small bin, big convenience: Perfect on your dressing table or in the kitchen for throwing away small bits of rubbish like cotton balls, makeup remover sheets, tea bags, food scraps, or even lint and dryer sheets.
lift-off lid: Lid comes off easily to empty contents.
easy to clean: Smooth plastic inner lining is easy to wipe clean.
fingerprint-proof: Fingerprint-proof finish resists smudges to keep stainless steel shiny.
description: The simplehuman mini can is perfect for your vanity and is ideal for throwing away cotton balls, makeup remover sheets, and eyeliner pencil shavings. Or use it on your kitchen countertop for quick disposal of tea bags, coffee pods, and food scraps; or in the laundry room for lint and dryer sheets. The balanced swing lid easily opens then gently swings back into place. The lid also easily lifts off to empty the contents, and the smooth plastic inner lining is a cinch to wipe clean.
